candidates.description: Real-time: holds a board or tray by its two side tabs with both hands, lifts it and tilts it so that a ball on it rolls along a route -- a tilt maze, a ball tray. It moves the hands to the tabs and closes them there itself: start it with both hands open, do not close them first. Bind hands to the board, ball to the ball, path to the cells to pass in order from the ball's cell, e.g. "A1 A2 B2". It ends when the ball rests in the goal's cup or at the route's last cell, and pauses (scene_changed: blocked) when the ball cannot go on along the route: answer with a new path (authored)
